hostedObservations.note: observations of the hosted run; the probe and the oracle assert none of these counts

limits: All five jobs completed successfully in the final attempt; this artifact audit certifies only the headless current network images lane (74 checks, the state after the review of PR #64).

The preceding-host control (30 normative failures among its 37 reachable checks) and the three retained sabotages (1, 34 and 2 failures) remain local evidence; this audit only shows that every check they fail and still exist passes in the hosted run. The hosted job runs the images example headless (test:examples) but not its capture lane with the native renderer (30 checks).
Bundle hashes and the native host hash are declared by the runner; no bundle or native binary is included in the artifact.
CI host hash is not required to equal the local built host.
Mobile and parity jobs are separate: only their PASSED markers are recorded, their outputs are not audited here.
Git-tree verification establishes tracked content at the pushed main checkout; it does not independently inspect a compiled native binary.
The slice's own committed limits are unchanged and still apply, except the one that says hosted CI had not run the slice, which this receipt supersedes (the rest of that limit still applies):
No disk cache: the byte cache is memory only, so nothing survives the application, and queryCache never answers disk or disk/memory.
No revalidation, Vary handling, cookies, compression, HTTP/2 or HTTP caching of redirects.

tintColor, blurRadius, capInsets, defaultSource, loadingIndicatorSource, fadeDuration, progressiveRenderingEnabled, resizeMethod, resizeMultiplier and overlayColor fail where the Image renders; a border radius on the Image's own style fails too (the host clips rectangles only).
Animated GIF and WebP, nativeImageSource, and an Image inside Text (a failure by design, as for every Control) are not delivered.

The transport and the caches ran against a Node server on loopback (HTTP and HTTPS with a test authority) and the example's own GDScript server; a remote server, a proxy, a captive portal and real network conditions were not exercised.
Assets and network pictures were loaded in the project's own run; no exported app, desktop export or Android export ran.
The captures were taken by the macOS native renderer at content scale 2; the pixel checks sample a few points and there is no independent pixel oracle of the whole frame.
ImageIO's rounding of a thumbnail's size, UIKit's exact tiling geometry, decode memory on a device and the caches' behavior under a real memory warning were not compared with iOS.

The oracle and the probe state values from what the host delivered or from bounds (four downloads at once, a margin of 20 s around every stale time), never from frame pace or from how the bytes were segmented.
Only macOS arm64 was executed; Windows, Linux, Android, iOS and Web runtimes are not covered.
GF-16 is open: this second slice closes no checkpoint, and no whole GF, other checkpoint, dependency, weight or denominator closes.
findings: explained, non-blocking: the runner's Node is v22.23.2 where the committed state ran v22.23.3; recorded as a fact, no comparison of a result depends on it here

ok: RN's own Image downloads over the host's HTTP transport, decodes on worker threads and keeps pictures in two memory caches
